newsitem.title: USA: Thorn Apple filed for debenture offering.
newsitem.headline: Thorn Apple filed for debenture offering.

text.p: Thorn Apple Valley Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement on February 21 with the Securities and Exchange Commission covering a proposed public offering of $15,000,000 in principal amount of convertible subordinated debentures.
Thorn Apple Valley also intends to grant the underwriters an option to purchase up to $2,500,000 additional convertible subordinated debentures to cover any overallotments.
Net proceeds from the sale of the debentures will be used to pay down a portion of the company's secured indebtedness, reducing its interest.
The managing underwriter for the proposed offering is Roney & Co.
Thorn Apple Valley produces processed meat and poultry products and is one of the largest slaughterers of hogs and sellers of related fresh pork products in the United States.
